Predictor Tool: Classifies the metric window into one objective six-way INCIDENT_CLASS plus a SEVERITY score and confidence. Do NOT convert incident_class to a routing category or guess severity — always call this first.
RAG Query Tool: Retrieves similar PAST INCIDENTS and matching RUNBOOK sections with citations (source_id, source_type, quote). Input: a short natural-language description of the current incident.
LangGraph Agent Tool: Runs deep multi-step Planner-Specialists-Synthesiser reasoning across infra, database and application specialists. Call ONLY for complex cross-domain incidents. Returns findings, owner_team and escalation_path grounded in the Tools API.
Service Context Tool: Returns the deterministic owner_team and escalation_path for the incident service. Call for routable, non-complex single-domain incidents after Predictor and RAG.
